Mit rund 23.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit arbeiten wir täglich daran, die drängendsten Wasserprobleme unserer Zeit zu lösen. Innerhalb des Segments Xylem Analytics Germany entwickeln und vertreiben wir an vier deutschen Standorten hochwertige Mess- und Analysesysteme. Sie begleiten den gesamten Qualitätsprozess von der Wareneingangsprüfung über die Bearbeitung von Reklamationen bis hin zur Analyse und nachhaltigen Lösung von Qualitätsproblemen. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit Produktion, Fachabteilungen und Lieferanten zusammen und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Qualitätsmanagements. jobs.description: Du bist ein erfahrener PHP/Laravel Fullstack-Entwickler mit mindestens 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung, beherrschst Laravel und MySQL und hast bereits mit AWS gearbeitet? Und vor allem: AI gehört für dich inzwischen selbstverständlich zur Softwareentwicklung? Dann suchen wir dich! Wir entwickeln eine SaaS-Plattform für die Daten- und AI-gestützte Optimierung von Digitalmarketing-Kampagnen, die bereits seit über fünf Jahren erfolgreich im Einsatz ist. Wie auch in unserem Produkt, verfolgen wir in unserer Softwareentwicklung konsequent eine AI-First-Strategie . Dabei verstehen wir AI nicht als gelegentliche Unterstützung beim Schreiben einzelner Funktionen. Coding Agents sind ein fester Bestandteil unseres Software Development Lifecycles. Von der Analyse eines Tickets über Implementierung und Tests bis hin zu Code Reviews und Dokumentation setzen wir AI gezielt dort ein, wo Aufgaben sinnvoll unterstützt oder übernommen werden können. Wir suchen Entwickler, die AI effektiv einsetzen und dadurch mehr Zeit für die Aufgaben haben, bei denen menschliche Erfahrung entscheidend ist: Architektur, technische Entscheidungen, Qualität und Verantwortung für das Ergebnis. Deshalb solltest du Claude Code oder OpenAI Codex bereits kennen und aktiv für deine tägliche Entwicklungsarbeit nutzen. Das sind deine Aufgaben: Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung unserer SaaS-Plattform mit Laravel und MySQL. Konzeption und Implementierung neuer Features und technischer Lösungen. Entwicklung, Anbindung und Integration von APIs. Nutzung von Coding Agents wie Claude Code oder Codex als festen Bestandteil deiner täglichen Entwicklungsarbeit. jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering
jobs.description: At Submittable , we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run 30,000 programs , welcomed 1.2 million applicants , and facilitated the distribution of more than $10 billion in funding through our products on behalf of our clients. We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity & Social Justice, Children & Education, Creative & Arts, Health & Wellness, Economic Justice & Opportunity, and Environment & Climate. At Submittable, technology and purpose converge, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful change. About the Role Submittable is hiring a Vice President of Engineering who is deeply technical, works hands-on, and builds with AI every day. You will report to the CTO and run engineering day to day: delivery, quality, reliability, cost, and the people who make them happen. We want a different VP than the old SaaS playbook produced. That playbook grew output by growing headcount and adding layers of management. We believe AI coding tools now let a small team of strong engineers ship what once took a team several times its size. We intend to run engineering that way. You will keep the organization lean, keep layers few, and raise output per engineer rather than the number of engineers. You cannot lead that change from a slide deck. You need to know firsthand what it is like to ship production software with AI agents, including where they fail. We expect you to have done this yourself in the last 12 months and to keep doing it here. Plan on roughly a fifth of your week going to hands-on technical work: reading and writing code, reviewing pull requests, working incidents, and building the tools your teams use. jobs.description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? About the team We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Circularity Order Lifecycle squad. We're the team behind Back Market's Trade-in program, the system that lets customers exchange their old devices for cash toward their next refurbished purchase. It's a win-win-win: customers get more purchasing power, refurbishers get quality supply, and the planet gets a break from unnecessary e-waste. To achieve this, our team is made up of seven engineers, an engineering manager and a product manager collaborating closely with designers, data analysts, operations and business partners. Join us and help build the features that make it easier for customers and refurbishers to complete successful trade-in journeys. Künstliche Intelligenz wird für uns zunehmend wichtiger – in unseren Produkten wie in der täglichen Arbeit. Dafür suchen wir jemanden in Vollzeit, der beides kann: KI-Lösungen selbst entwickeln und Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Produktverantwortliche dafür gewinnen, sie tatsächlich zu nutzen. KI-Experte (m/w/d) Was dich erwartet: KI-Funktionen direkt in unsere Produkte integrieren: Chat- und Assistenzfunktionen, generative Modelle sowie Automatisierung auf Basis von Kundendaten und Kursstrukturen – von der Prototypentwicklung über die Architektur bis zum Produktivbetrieb, inklusive Prompt-Design, RAG-Aufbau und Evaluierung Technisch fundierte Entscheidungen treffen: Auswahl von Modell, Infrastruktur und Schnittstelle je Anwendungsfall – auf Basis unseres Stufenkonzepts, mit Gestaltungsspielraum in der konkreten Umsetzung Entwicklerteams bei der Umsetzung unterstützen: Pairing und Code-Reviews bei KI-Integrationen, Bereitstellung wiederverwendbarer Bibliotheken, Prompts und Muster, Ansprechperson bei technischen Fragestellungen zur KI-Integration KI-Systeme im laufenden Betrieb überwachen, analysieren und kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln Anwendungsfälle gemeinsam mit Produktteams und Entwicklung erarbeiten Verständliche Dokumentation und Schulungsunterlagen für Kolleginnen und Kollegen ohne KI-Hintergrund erstellen Aktuelle KI-Entwicklungen bewerten und einschätzen, welche Trends für ein Softwarehaus mit sensiblen Kundendaten (u. a. kirchliche Träger, öffentliche Einrichtungen) relevant sind Was du mitbringen solltest: Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Modellen (z. B. NLP) sowie mit GenAI/LLMs: Prompt-Engineering, RAG, API-Integration (Anthropic, OpenAI o. Ä.) und ein fundiertes Verständnis für deren Grenzen und Fehlerquellen Solide Programmierkenntnisse, idealerweise in Python, NodeJS, Svelte, sowie sicherer Umgang mit Daten und Datenbanken

Unsere Software unterstützt Bildungseinrichtungen dabei, ihre Arbeit einfacher, strukturierter und menschlicher zu gestalten. Dafür brauchen wir Menschen, die mitdenken, Verantwortung übernehmen und Lust haben, gemeinsam etwas Sinnvolles zu bewegen. Willkommen bei Kufer – Software für Bildung. Lösung für Menschen. DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) Wir bauen unsere Plattform gerade neu auf – weg von On-Premises, hin zu einer modernen, Kubernetes-basierten SaaS-Infrastruktur. Keine „wir machen schon immer Kubernetes“-Rolle, sondern die Chance, aktiv mitzugestalten, mit kurzen Wegen und echter Verantwortung. Als DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) verantwortest du den stabilen, sicheren Betrieb unserer Kubernetes-Infrastruktur in Cloud und On-Premises, automatisierst die Deployment-Strecke gemeinsam mit unseren Entwicklungsteams und treibst voran, wie KI-Agenten sinnvoll in unsere Betriebsprozesse einfließen. Was dich an Aufgaben erwartet: Betrieb, Wartung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Kubernetes-basierten Infrastruktur (SaaS und On-Premises) sowie Aufbau und Pflege von CI/CD-Pipelines (z. B. Azure DevOps) Mitgestaltung agentischer Automatisierung: KI-Agenten sinnvoll in Deployment- und Betriebsprozesse einbinden, statt jeden Handgriff manuell zu wiederholen Unterstützung der .NET-Teams im Produktbetrieb (Deployment, Monitoring, Release- und Rollout-Themen) Troubleshooting und Monitoring über Infrastruktur-, Netzwerk- und Applikationsebene hinweg zur Sicherstellung von Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität Mitgestaltung von Security-Maßnahmen im Betrieb (z. About the role We're looking for an engineer to drive the evolution of OrioleDB and its collaboration with the upstream PostgreSQL community. OrioleDB is a next-generation storage engine for PostgreSQL, and this role sits at the intersection of database internals, open source community work, and Supabase's managed Postgres platform. This role requires strong working overlap with Americas time zones due to production support and on-call responsibilities. What you'll work on New OrioleDB features. Ensure regressions are caught early and that OrioleDB behaves predictably under stress, replication, and failure scenarios. Upstream collaboration. Contribute changes directly to PostgreSQL core. Part of OrioleDB lives as a patch on top of PostgreSQL — moving the right pieces upstream shrinks what we maintain ourselves and benefits the wider community. This happens through PostgreSQL's open development process: the pgsql-hackers mailing list, public code review, and commitfests. Supabase integration. Work with Supabase's Postgres team to ensure OrioleDB fits naturally into Supabase's managed offering and roadmap. jobs.description: Hi I’m Colin , Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby . To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby. When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way). To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path. We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

jobs.title: Real Estate Business Developer
jobs.description: Decathlon Philippines is committed to a strategic, multi-year expansion initiative to better serve our customers across the region! To accompany this fast development, we are looking for a Real Estate Business Developer to develop, execute and manage business development projects leading to a profitable and sustainable growth for Decathlon within a dedicated zone/region. Key Responsibilities 1. Develop Local Expansion Strategy Define the vision and strategy for Decathlon's development (including stores and other formats) within the territory to increase market share. This includes: Analyzing market data (traffic, sales performance, competition, etc.). Designing the multi-channel network and planning the implementation of new solutions (e.g., shops, lockers, digital points), ensuring alignment with the Country Project. 2. Lead Project Development & Execution Manage the full lifecycle of real estate projects, including new openings and relocations: Source, negotiate, and secure sites (purchases/leases). Execute projects: Prepare studies, validate technical/financial details, secure permits, coordinate legal aspects, and control the budget. Manage local relationships with administrative/political bodies, and proactively advise on and execute physical partnerships and new business initiatives. 3. Manage Real Estate Portfolio Oversee the optimization and performance of the existing real estate assets: Track the financial performance (revenue/costs vs. budget) during a project's first year. Identify and execute store optimization opportunities (e.g., downsizing, enlarging, efficiency improvements, or green building investments). Execute land commercialization actions (sales or commercialization of vacant premises), following Asset Manager guidelines.
